design.question: Are Shakti's opening-strong signs the animal signs - Spec 070's question re-asked unchanged on the surface Spec 073 repaired (Registry v2 / Asset A v2), the predecessor's POPULATION NOT KEYED closure standing unamended
design.battery: The recovered Phase-43 battery applied new to Shakti (section 2): sequences of length >= 2, I/M/T by position, floor total >= 5, cascade TERMINAL_STRONG t_rate >= 0.60, INITIAL_STRONG i_rate >= 0.55, MEDIAL_STRONG m_rate >= 0.65, TERMINAL_MODERATE t_rate >= 0.40, INITIAL_MODERATE i_rate >= 0.40, MIXED; threshold-only, no chance baseline (G5 attestation mandatory); the Phase-43 counts (805/2,267; the 40/61/20 classes) are never a basis for any product
design.populations: Primary: documented-lineage rows only. Sensitivity S-C: documented + corroborated rows, classes and counts re-derived; rows graded undocumented-uncorroborated enter no count anywhere
design.test: O is the INITIAL_STRONG set, enumerated in full in Wells space and published before any join, and asserted at gate 0.4 to reproduce Spec 070's recorded 31 signs exactly (DD-074-9); U is every sign with >= 30 occurrences in the primary population under the counting rule carried from DD-070-10; R1 is the animal share of O over the animal share of U, Fisher exact on the disjoint 2x2 (O against U minus O), the one-sided p the criterion and the two-sided p published; R2 the reversed arm
design.precedence: Section 4.3, carried from Spec 049's DD-049-3 through Spec 070: NOT SUPPORTED if R1 <= 1.0 or p >= 0.05; SUPPORTED if R1 >= 1.5, p < 0.05 and R2 > 1.0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
design.keying: DD-074-8 (two-leg): leg 1 is DD-070-9 carried - a Shakti sign's ICIT code is its Wells number, resolved through the canonical registry v2's parpola_1982 rows' wells_ids to exactly one Asset A v2 sign_key; leg 2, for a sign with no attested Wells code in the Phase-433 record, Registry v2's icit_wells rows are consulted, the row's sign_id being the sign's own Wells code, to the Asset A v2 row of that sign_key; zero or multiple resolutions across both legs is unkeyable
design.disposition: DD-074-10 (conservative; DD-070-11 carried unchanged): an unkeyable sign enumerated in the opening-strong set closes the execution at gate 0.4 as POPULATION NOT KEYED, the sign named
design.sensitivities: S-A contested Asset A v2 rows included under their CISI-governed labels (Asset A v2 carries zero contested rows, so S-A equals the primary and is reported as such); S-B unicorn removed, the sign(s) named at gate 0.5 from the frozen asset's verbatim labels or S-B recorded not applicable; S-C the corroborated sensitivity
design.osf: DD-074-11: this spec files its own OSF registration at its freeze under the programme's OSF project; the filing is recorded in osf-spec-registration.md in this directory
design.execution_gate: Phase 440 executes only against this frozen record; step 0 asserts the repaired surface (gate 0.1: Registry v2 and Asset A v2 against Spec 073's executed record) and the Shakti intake under P-F1 S1/S2 (gate 0.2), checks input integrity (gate 0.3), then enumerates the population, asserts its reproduction of Spec 070's recorded measurement, and keys it (gate 0.4), publishes the comparison census (gate 0.5), and gives the freeze-order proof (gate 0.6) before any test quantity
design.limits: Depiction is the published identification layer, not ground truth; Spec 037's 49 percent census caution travels with every statement of the result; no outcome establishes that animal signs marked identity, a guild, or goods
